content.value_statement: Teams often need visual artifacts to match Anthropic brand styling without manual cleanup. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to apply defined colors, typography, and hierarchy.
actual_capabilities: Provides Anthropic dark, light, mid gray, and light gray color values.
Provides orange, blue, and green accent colors for non-text elements.
Maps headings to Poppins with Arial fallback.
Maps body text to Lora with Georgia fallback.
Guides smart color selection based on background contrast.
Describes use of RGB color values for presentation styling.
limitations: It does not install Poppins or Lora fonts.
It does not guarantee trademark approval or official brand compliance.
It provides guidance only and includes no executable automation scripts.
Results depend on the target document format and available styling APIs.

use_cases.title: Style executive presentations
use_cases.description: Apply brand colors, heading fonts, body fonts, and accents to presentation decks.

use_cases.title: Polish customer artifacts
use_cases.description: Bring reports, proposals, and visual summaries closer to Anthropic visual standards.

use_cases.title: Review brand consistency
use_cases.description: Check whether colors, typography, and hierarchy match the documented brand guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Apply basic styling
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single artifact.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the brand-guidelines skill to this artifact. Use the documented colors, heading font, body font, and accent color guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh a presentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this presentation and update the visual styling with the brand-guidelines skill. Preserve the message while improving colors, typography, and hierarchy.

prompt_templates.title: Audit brand alignment
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this artifact against the brand-guidelines skill. List color, typography, and hierarchy issues, then recommend focused fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a styled system
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for repeatable design rules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the brand-guidelines skill to create a repeatable styling plan for a document set. Include colors, typography, accents, and review criteria.

output_examples.input: A slide deck uses mixed fonts, bright colors, and inconsistent accent shapes.
output_examples.output: The deck is restyled with Poppins headings, Lora body text, dark primary text, light backgrounds, and controlled orange, blue, and green accents.

output_examples.input: A report needs a quick brand consistency review before sharing.
output: Headings should use Poppins or Arial fallback.
Body text should use Lora or Georgia fallback.
Accent shapes should use the documented orange, blue, or green values.

output_examples.input: A proposal requires an Anthropic-inspired visual treatment.
output_examples.output: The proposal receives a restrained palette, readable typography, and accent colors that support the content without changing the core message.

best_practices: Confirm the artifact type before applying formatting changes.
Preserve existing information hierarchy while updating visual style.
Check font availability and use documented fallbacks when needed.
anti_patterns: Do not claim official approval from Anthropic based only on this skill.
Do not replace content strategy with color and font changes.
Do not apply accent colors so heavily that readability suffers.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps apply documented Anthropic brand colors, typography, and visual hierarchy to artifacts.

faq.question: Does it install brand fonts?
faq.answer: No. It uses Poppins and Lora when available and recommends Arial and Georgia fallbacks.

faq.question: Can it style presentations?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes guidance for colors, typography, shapes, and RGB color values.

faq.question: Is this official Anthropic approval?
faq.answer: No. It is community-provided guidance and should not be treated as legal or brand approval.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it run commands or scripts?
faq.answer: No. The skill content is Markdown guidance and does not include executable scripts.
